title: On abelian complex structures on Nilpotent Lie Algebras
summary: We provide a new approach to the classification, up to equivalence, of abelian complex structures on nilpotent Lie algebras. As an application, we recover the already known classifications in dimensions 4 and 6 and provide a classification in dimension 8 for 1-abelian complex structures. Some results about the general case are given.
